owner_decision: Option B, chosen by the owner in chat on 2026-10-11 after the work machine (CPU flags: avx2, no avx512f) failed the startup golden self-test with GOLDEN_SELF_TEST_FAILED:band_6_bc_margin,end_to_end_6_margin.
purpose: Let the unchanged service become ready on x86-64 CPUs without AVX-512 by widening only the golden self-test's numeric margin tolerances, if and only if the service's card-level answers do not change on such CPUs.

base.parent_is: depi ocr-team/national-id tip, verified by git ls-remote on 2026-10-11

hard_lines: No model, weight, decoder, decider threshold (0.966875), engine margin, pipeline, preprocessing or sealed-module change.

No change to golden_expected.json, golden_fixtures.npz or any stored golden value; exact golden checks (argmax, Paddle text hash, detector accepted, admission status, admitted, sealed known-prediction hashes) stay exact.
Only the numeric tolerance constants in src/service/golden.py may change, and only by the rule below.
Development cards only (the 296-file enginev2 container selection); no audit, internal-validation, external-test or external-validation card; no new labels; no human review.
No national ID printed or committed; no force push; national-id2 untouched.

instrument.emulation: oneDNN's ONEDNN_MAX_CPU_ISA cap (honoured by TensorFlow and Paddle) on the AVX-512 development laptop emulates CPUs without AVX-512. Caps measured: AVX2, AVX, SSE41. DEFAULT (no cap) is the control.
instrument.harness: scripts/phase4_golden_isa.py measure: the in-process service (the shipped Recognizer and app) with the golden self-test recorded instead of enforced, the same 296-file selection and typed-ID pairs as phase4_final.py container-subset, compared field by field with the sealed reference rows artifacts/phase4_final/service/service_rows_wsl.json.
validation: Synthetic ground truth: the comparator's built-in self-check on constructed row pairs with known mismatches must count them exactly before any real row is read.
Known answer: under DEFAULT the golden drifts are at most 1e-8 and the comparison is 296/296 equal in all 11 fields; otherwise INSTRUMENT_FAIL and nothing is decided.
Real hardware: the emulated AVX2 golden failure names must equal those the work machine reported (band_6_bc_margin, end_to_end_6_margin).
instrument-validator subagent review of the harness before the decision is computed.

decision_gate.unit: file (card image) level, 296 development files, each sent with an honest and a typo typed ID, per cap.
decision_gate.go: For every cap (AVX2, AVX, SSE41), all 296 files equal the reference in all 10 answer fields. The 11th field, confidence (the margin), is numeric and is reported: max absolute difference, and the count of reference files whose margin lies within that difference of 0.966875.
decision_gate.no_go: Any answer-field mismatch under any cap. Then no tolerance changes, the decision is GOLDEN_ISA_NO_GO, and the recommendation is to run on an AVX-512 host (option A).

tolerance_rule.applies_to: BAND_TOLERANCE and END_TO_END_MARGIN_TOLERANCE; DETECTOR_SCORE_TOLERANCE, DETECTOR_CORNER_TOLERANCE and PADDLE_CONFIDENCE_TOLERANCE only if their observed drift exceeds their current value.
tolerance_rule.formula: new = max(current, 4 x the largest drift observed for that check across AVX2, AVX and SSE41), rounded up to one significant digit.

verification_after_change.golden: scripts/golden_diagnose.sh on the rebuilt image prints GOLDEN_OK under DEFAULT, AVX2, AVX and SSE41.
verification_after_change.default_parity: phase4_final.py container-subset on the rebuilt image without a cap: 296/296 equal in all 11 fields (behaviour on AVX-512 unchanged).
verification_after_change.avx2_container: The rebuilt image run with ONEDNN_MAX_CPU_ISA=AVX2 becomes healthy; container-subset against it equals the reference in the 10 answer fields for all 296 files, and /engine answers 200 for the synthetic image.
verification_after_change.health: fast target, privacy scan (no skip), lint as before; full suite as phase4-repo amendment 1.
verification_after_change.frozen: phase4_final.py check all_pass true at entry and at exit; docker/model_files.sha256 and every sealed module unchanged.
verification_after_change.work_machine: Owner runs the rebuilt service on the work machine: /ready 200 (reported by the owner; not a gate this task can execute).

amendments.reason: The owner's work-machine golden drifts (default threads: band 1.0674418298273203e-05, end-to-end 0.002129045956467679, Paddle 1.8116317745953125e-07) showed that capping oneDNN alone left Paddle's drift different (MKL dispatch) and OpenCV/NumPy still on AVX-512. With MKL capped, band and Paddle drifts equal the work machine's to the last digit; the end-to-end drift still differs, attributed to library thread counts (the work-machine command ran with its library default threads). A first measurement batch with the oneDNN-only cap was stopped before it wrote any result.
amendments.instrument: Each cap now sets ONEDNN_MAX_CPU_ISA, MKL_ENABLE_INSTRUCTIONS, OPENCV_CPU_DISABLE (OpenCV's name AVX512-SKX, verified by cv2.getCPUFeaturesLine marking it disabled) and NPY_DISABLE_CPU_FEATURES, inside scripts/phase4_golden_isa.py before any library loads, and the harness caps library threads at 4 as the image's OCR_CPU_THREADS=4 does.
amendments.added_validation: Real-hardware numeric check: the owner runs the golden drift with configure_threads(4) on the work machine; the decision is computed only if the band, end-to-end and Paddle drifts equal the emulated AVX2 drifts with 4 threads, or the difference is reported and judged before the decision.

amendments.written_while: the DEFAULT control was still running; no measurement output existed (artifacts/phase4_golden_isa/ absent).
amendments.control_bound: Under DEFAULT the golden drifts must be at most 1e-8 for band margin, end-to-end margin, detector score and detector corners, and at most 1e-6 for Paddle confidence. Reason: a container diagnostic with configure_threads(4) and no cap, run before amendment 1 but not carried into it, gave Paddle confidence drift 1.778e-7 (band 4.47e-9, end-to-end 4.98e-9); the stored golden Paddle values come from a different thread setting. PADDLE_CONFIDENCE_TOLERANCE is 1e-3, so this is far from any check. The card-level control (296/296 equal in all 11 fields) is unchanged.
instrument_validator_conditions_adopted: Each output must report files == 296; decide on equal_in_10_answer_fields == files == 296, not on answer_field_mismatches being empty (it also holds confidence_presence).
Before applying the tolerance formula, inspect failed_checks: an end-to-end margin check that fails while end_to_end_margin reports 0.0 (a missing margin) blocks the formula for that check.
A NO_GO is broken down by status code (non-answers vs wrong answers) and any 500/503 is re-measured before it counts.
reference_margins_within_max_diff_of_threshold is reported as a lower bound (float comparison can drop exact ties on the 6-decimal grid); it is not gating.
amendments.harness: Unchanged for this batch: scripts/phase4_golden_isa.py as committed in e932533 (sha256 prefix b071285b3de84aa1). The validator's code fixes (assert 296, integer-millionths exposure, status breakdown, unmeasured end-to-end drift) are applied only if a rerun is needed.
